report:
Breast, left, wide local excision

The specimen consists of a left wide local excision specimen (95 g, 70 x 55 x 40 mm). Sectioning reveals a firm, well-circumscribed, lobulated tumour measuring 45 mm in greatest dimension (45 x 40 x 35 mm) in the upper outer quadrant (2 o'clock), 3 mm from the anterior margin. The remaining breast tissue is fibrofatty and unremarkable.

(1-6) tumour with the closest anterior margin.
(7-10) posterior, superior, inferior and lateral margins.
(11) medial margin.
(12) background breast.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Excision (less than total mastectomy)
- Specimen laterality: Left
- Tumour site: Upper outer quadrant (2 o'clock)
- Tumour size: Greatest dimension 45 mm (45 x 40 x 35 mm)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Phyllodes tumour, borderline
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show a fibroepithelial tumour measuring 45 mm with leaf-like fronds
  lined by a bland bilayered epithelium and moderate stromal cellularity, mild
  stromal atypia and no stromal overgrowth; mitoses number 6 per 10 high power
  fields. The border is focally infiltrative into the surrounding breast. No
  malignant heterologous element is seen. The features are those of a borderline
  phyllodes tumour.
- Stromal cellularity: Moderate (some overlapping stromal nuclei)
- Stromal atypia: Mild (minimal variation in nuclear size, even chromatin, and
  smooth nuclear contours)
- Stromal overgrowth: Absent
- Mitotic rate: 6 per 10 high power fields
- Histologic tumour border: Infiltrative (permeative), focal
- Malignant heterologous elements: Not identified
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Epithelial component: Bland bilayered epithelium

Surgical margins
- Anterior margin: Uninvolved by tumour, closest distance: 3 mm
- Posterior margin: Uninvolved by tumour, closest distance: 8 mm
- Superior margin: Uninvolved by tumour, closest distance: greater than 10 mm
- Inferior margin: Uninvolved by tumour, closest distance: greater than 10 mm
- Medial margin: Uninvolved by tumour, closest distance: greater than 10 mm
- Lateral margin: Uninvolved by tumour, closest distance: greater than 10 mm

Regional lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: No lymph nodes submitted or found

Distant metastasis
- Distant metastasis: Not applicable

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: Not applicable (borderline phyllodes tumour; AJCC staging applies to
  malignant phyllodes tumour only)

Additional findings
- Additional pathologic findings: Not identified

BREAST, left, wide local excision
- BORDERLINE PHYLLODES TUMOUR, 45 mm; margins clear (closest 3 mm, anterior);
  see synoptic report

Borderline phyllodes tumours are usually excised with a clear margin of at least 10 mm; the 3 mm anterior margin is noted for the clinical team's consideration of re-excision.

checks.message: Borderline phyllodes tumour within 10 mm of the anterior and posterior margins (3 mm, 8 mm): a comment on re-excision is added.
